title: The Hunt - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: The Hunt trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: The Hunt phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A named story boss. The fight is the first real test of the parry window rather than the dodge.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Defeat the Hunt, Hunter of the Order.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 6 of 36 on the list - before it The Four Freed · after it The Shattered Mirror. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
